articles.title: Securitize eyes acquisitions with $400 million war chest after going public, CEO says
articles.snippet: Following its NYSE debut, Securitize CEO Carlos Domingo said the firm wants to expand its institutional tokenization platform rather than buy competitors.

articles.title: Michael Saylor's Strategy dramatically ups pace of bitcoin sales, raising $216 million
articles.snippet: The company sold 3,588 bitcoin last week to replenish its dollar reserves for dividends on its preferred stock.

articles.title: Ripple's preliminary crypto asset provider license in Luxembourg upgraded to fully compliant
articles.snippet: The approval means Ripple is now fully MiCA-compliant for payments, financial institutions, corporates and businesses across all 30 European Economic Area countries.

articles.title: Bollinger Bands creator eyes Bitcoin bear-market end, 'W'-shaped reversal
articles.snippet: Bitcoin price strength could "break" the entire downtrend if the reversal pattern completed, John Bollinger suggested in light of the BTC rebound.

articles.title: What Is Q-Day? The Quantum Threat to Bitcoin Explained
articles.snippet: Experts warn quantum computers could someday forge Bitcoin’s digital signatures, allowing unauthorized transactions.
